title: UI project accounting: tolerate a non-monotonic wall clock in Vitest file windows
outcome: UI project accounting: tolerate a non-monotonic wall clock in Vitest file windows
acceptance: A deterministic witness first fails on the current planner: a report whose file windows reflect a backward wall-clock step fails accounting although every test passed.
The planner distinguishes a non-monotonic report from an order or overlap violation, without relaxing any coverage status and without ever reporting a pass it did not observe.
The full five-stage gate passes; its run directory and fingerprint are cited in a note.
